title: Formation of the anchored made field: place-dependent and uniform parts

key_results.statement: Every $L$, both graphs, $M\to\infty$ first, exact for the means: $\delta a(x,\lambda)=-[(1-\cos\sqrt{K_a}\lambda)K_a^{-1}]_{xx_s}$, $u=[\cos(\sqrt{K_a}\lambda)K_a^{-1}]_{xx_s}$, $\delta a_{\rm st}=-G_a(x,x_s)$; the state at $\lambda$ is $\Omega$ displaced by the means, so its connected equal-time correlations ($w$ among them) are those of $\Omega$.
Laplace transform of the made field: $\widehat{\delta a}(x,s)=-R_{xx_s}(s)/s$ with the resolvent (5.9), every $L$, both graphs.

Image representation: $\delta a=\delta a_0(x-x_s,\lambda)+\int_0^\lambda S_0(x-h,\lambda-\lambda')\sigma_h(\lambda')d\lambda'$, with image strength $\sigma_h=-\kappa_a\delta a(h,\cdot)$ solving a Volterra equation, $\hat\sigma_h=\kappa_a\gamma_s(x_s-h)/\{s[1+\kappa_a\gamma_s(0)]\}$; static image strength 1.

Uniform part = place average $\bar U(\lambda)=-L^{-D}\int_0^\lambda(\lambda-\lambda')[1-\sigma_h(\lambda')]d\lambda'$ (net force of source and image); place-dependent part $\delta a^\perp=\delta a-\bar U$; every $L$, both graphs.
Static values of the two parts equal the uniform shift and the place-dependent part of (5.11): $\bar U_{\rm st}=-[1/\kappa_a+r(x_s,h)/2]$, $\delta a^\perp_{\rm st}=g(x-h)-g(x-x_s)$.
Laplace transform of the uniform part: $\hat{\bar U}(s)=-s^{-1}\{1+\kappa_a[\tilde\gamma_s(0)-\tilde\gamma_s(x_s-h)]\}/\{\kappa_a+L^Ds^2[1+\kappa_a\tilde\gamma_s(0)]\}$, every $L$, both graphs.

At every finite $L$, both graphs: the $\lambda$-mean of $\delta a$, $\bar U$, $\delta a^\perp$ is the static value, and $\delta a$ returns arbitrarily close to $0$ at arbitrarily large $\lambda$; so neither part meets (4.11), (4.19) or (9.1) for any $\varepsilon<1$ at fixed $L$.

Order $L\to\infty$ first, then $\rho\to\infty$ at fixed $w=c_0\lambda/\rho\neq1$: the free unpinned field forms at the front, $\rho\,\delta a_0\to-\theta(w-1)/(4\pi\kappa_h)$ ($D=3$, the step in every direction), $\nabla\delta a_0\to\theta(w-1)/(2\kappa_h)$ ($D=1$); front speed = largest slope of the normal-mode frequency = $c_0$.

Order $L\to\infty$ first, $d_s\to\infty$ on the scale $\lambda\propto d_s$: $\sigma_h\to\beta\,\theta(c_0\lambda-d_s)$ with $\beta=g_\infty(x_s-h)/c_\phi$ ($D=3$, $\kappa_a\neq\kappa_h/\gamma_3$) and $\beta=1$ ($D=1$).

Cubic torus, order $L\to\infty$, then $\rho\to\infty$ along an axis at fixed $w$, $a=d_s/\rho$, $b=d_x/\rho\neq1$: for $\kappa_a\neq\kappa_h/\gamma_3$, $\Delta_3^\perp\to-1$ ($w<1$), $1/(b-1)$ ($w>1$), and $c_0\lambda_{\rm form}/\rho\to1$ if $b>1+1/\varepsilon$, controlled in every later $\lambda$ by (9.17), (9.18); for every $\kappa_a$, $\lambda_{\rm form}=\infty$ for large $\rho$ if $|b-1|<1/\varepsilon$ (by the $\lambda$-mean); $b=1+1/\varepsilon$ undecided; far from the anchor (distances to $h\to\infty$ at fixed $\rho$, then $\rho\to\infty$) $c_0\lambda_{\rm form}/\rho\to1$ for every $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$, speed $c_0$, independent of $\kappa_a$.

Cubic torus, radial $\Phi$, order $L\to\infty$, then $\ell\to\infty$ at fixed $w$ and $a=d_s/\ell>2$ (weighted reference $\propto1-\theta_a\neq0$): the shell criterion (4.19) for $\delta a^\perp$ gives $c_0\lambda_{\rm form}/\ell\to w_\varepsilon\in[1,2]$ if $\theta_a<\varepsilon/(1+\varepsilon)$ ($\kappa_a\neq\kappa_h/\gamma_3$, $\Psi$ strictly decreasing at $w_\varepsilon$), and $\lambda_{\rm form}=\infty$ for large $\ell$ if $\theta_a>\varepsilon/(1+\varepsilon)$ (every $\kappa_a$); formation in the mean by $c_0\lambda\le2\ell$ as $a\to\infty$, never for $a<(1+\varepsilon)/\varepsilon$.

Ring (control), order $L\to\infty$, then $\rho\to\infty$ at fixed $w$ and $a=d_s/\rho>1$, observation between source and anchor: $\Delta_1\to-1,-1/2,0$ on $w<1$, $1<w<2a-1$, $w>2a-1$, uniformly away from $w=1,2a-1$, and $\Delta_1\in[-1/2,0.14]+o(1)$ across the image front; for $\varepsilon<1/2$, $c_0\lambda_{\rm form}/\rho\to2a-1$, so with the anchor far ($a\to\infty$) no formation within any $\lambda$ linear in $\rho$; for $\varepsilon>1/2$ the limit is 1.

Cubic torus as $L\to\infty$, uniformly in $\lambda\ge0$: $\bar U=\bar U_{\rm st}[1-\cos(\lambda/T_U)]+O(L^{-1})|\bar U_{\rm st}|$, $T_U=\sqrt{L^3c_\phi^{(L)}}[1+O(L^{-2})]$ (depends on $\kappa_a$ via $c_\phi$, not on $d_s$); slow mode carries the oscillating image $-(1-\beta_L)g(x-h)$; same form on the ring for $\kappa_aL\ll\kappa_h$ with $T_U\simeq(L/\kappa_a)^{1/2}$.

Ring, $L\to\infty$ at fixed $c_0\lambda/L$ and $d_s/L$ ($\kappa_aL\gg\kappa_h$): $\bar U=-(L/2\kappa_h)[f(\alpha)-f(\alpha+\tau)/2-f(\alpha-\tau)/2]+O(L^0)$, a string fixed at the anchor, periodic with period $2L/c_0$ between $0$ and $2\bar U_{\rm st}$; with (9.8)-(9.10) and (9.18) the uniform part reaches its static value in no order of the limits, only as a $\lambda$-mean.

Cubic torus, $\kappa_a\neq\kappa_h/\gamma_3$, grips square with a common $\hat\beta$: in the order $L\to\infty$, then $d/\ell\to\infty$, then $\ell\to\infty$ at fixed $w$, the long-range mark (5.15)(a) and the weighing of 05-anchor (within (A), or (B) with $R/d\to0$; controlled regime, order $\mu^2$, leading order in the grip; lowest-eigenvector form iff also (5.10), (5.26)) as properties of lowest eigenvectors, and the formation within a $\lambda$ linear in the distance at speed $c_0$ for every $\varepsilon$ as a property of the evolution from $\Omega$, are available together at leading order in $\ell/d$; a weighing in the evolving state is not claimed; formation fails for small $\varepsilon$ with formation places at distances from $h$ comparable to $\rho$, and in order O2.

Cubic lattice, uniformly in $\lambda$: $\rho|u_0(\rho\mathbf e_1,\lambda)|\le C_\delta\rho^{-1/3}$ for $c_0\lambda\ge(1+\delta)\rho$ (folds of condition (d) only along the axis), $|\delta a_0(y,\lambda)|\le C/|y|$ for all $\lambda$, $\int_0^\infty|S_0(y,\lambda)|d\lambda\le C|y|^{-1/6}$ (dispersive bound $\lambda^{-7/6}$ set by the rank-one points, low-label Airy front).

Cubic lattice with the anchor, order $L\to\infty$: the $\lambda$-mean of $\delta a^\infty$ is $-g_\infty(x-x_s)+\beta g_\infty(x-h)$ for every $\kappa_a$, so the uniform part and an image of strength $1-\beta$ never form; for $\kappa_a\neq\kappa_h/\gamma_3$ the image term obeys $\sup_\lambda|I|\le C/(d_xd_s^{1/6})+O(e^{-(d_x+d_s)/\xi})$; for $\kappa_a>\kappa_h/\gamma_3$ a localized mode adds a persistent oscillation of size $O(e^{-(d_x+d_s)/\xi})$.

orders of limits O1 (L first) and O2 (lambda growing with L)

open_issues: The bounds (9.17), (9.18) are stated without constants; (9.17) uses the dispersive bound λ^{-7/6} of the lattice wave equation on Z³ and uniform Airy asymptotics of the low-label front as standard results; at ρ ≤ 16 the code shows wakes of 0.30 to 0.16 decaying about as ρ^{-0.4}, so formation at ε ≲ 0.3 is delayed there and the code's formation times are finite-window values.

At the threshold κ_a = κ_h/γ_3 (D = 3) the anchor kernel decays only as λ^{-1/2}; the image statements (9.10), (9.18) second part, the profile and positive parts of (9.11), (9.12), and (9.16) are not derived there.
The shell criterion is treated only for radial Φ.
The error terms of (9.14) are upper bounds; the code finds much smaller deviations.
In order O2 on the cubic torus the non-slow modes beyond the wrap time are controlled only by (9.8); no criterion restricted to a window of λ is studied.
Item 4 uses the weighing of 05-anchor as quoted in words; whether a weighing is realized in the evolving state, through a dynamical observable, is not studied.
The ring with κ_a L comparable to κ_h is not treated; (9.14) and (9.15) are its two limits.

consistency_checks.check: Far from the anchor (9.11) reduces to (4.12) at μ = 0 and to the μ → 0 limit of (4.13)
Limit κ_a → ∞: finite T_U, β < 1, exact fixed point on the ring, (9.6) reduces to (5.11) at 1/κ_a = 0
